detail.longDescription:
Run your day. Run your business. Choose your AI.

OpenAlly brings AI agents and practical apps together for individuals and businesses. Plan work, organize knowledge, build a website, manage inventory, turn a customer request into an order, make an invoice, and continue from mobile to Mac.

Keep the work connected instead of copying it between a chatbot, notes app, stock sheet and invoice tool. Each agent uses only the knowledge, skills and access you choose.

For everyday work

• Research information, summarize documents, plan projects and trips, draft replies, check weather and set reminders.• Add PDFs, web pages and notes to a private knowledge base, then ask questions across them.• Capture, transcribe and summarize voice notes.• Follow trending open-source projects, connect image or video services, build a Vibe Page, or try playful features such as Slap.• Use a personal AI assistant or focused agents for research, writing, planning and support.

Run your business from mobile

OpenAlly includes business and inventory management tools, not just chat.

• Manage products, variants, prices, taxes, inventory and stock.• Keep customers, bookings, orders and sales records together.• Use the invoice maker for numbered invoices and receipts, then share them.• Make payment links through a connected provider and reconcile payments. Methods may include cards, UPI, netbanking or wallets, depending on provider and region.• Move a request through quote, cart, order, payment option and invoice without typing the same details again.• Give sales, support, research or operations work to focused agents.

Build useful things

Need a website, web app, menu, form or shareable page? Describe it in App Builder, then edit, preview and publish from OpenAlly. Vibe Pages gives you a faster mobile canvas for a simple page or idea.

Remote Deck turns your phone into a controller for approved Mac actions. You can also shape a small tool, explore a trend, create media through a connected provider or make something simply for fun.

Automate with control

For supported Android screen tasks, pair the separate, optional, open-source Aster companion. Teach an approved routine, replay it later and keep the run visible. Aster returns control at logins, payments and other sensitive steps, and you can stop it at any time.

Choose your AI

Choose from 20+ AI providers. Bring an API key, use a supported subscription, connect a compatible server you run, select a supported local model, or use OpenAlly Cloud. Different agents can use different models. Change providers without rebuilding agents, apps or business records. No model or provider lock-in.

Health — See your steps, heart rate, sleep and weight as graphs, and your distance, active calories and exercise sessions as dated entries, so changes stand out. You choose what OpenAlly may read from Health Connect; it never writes back and keeps it in an encrypted vault on your phone. Track medicines and dose reminders, and add prescriptions and lab reports — results become values you can check and follow over time. OpenAlly is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition.

Connect where it helps

WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack and Signal extend a workflow. Turn a WhatsApp conversation into an order and payment option. Give a Telegram bot a focused job, bring support into a team chat or send an alert where it will be seen.

Privacy with clear boundaries

Your conversations, agents, knowledge and business records are stored on your device. A supported local request stays there. When you choose your own AI provider, it receives what the request needs under its terms. OpenAlly Cloud processes requests when you choose it.

Keys and account credentials use protected device storage. Optional backups are encrypted before upload to your private OpenAlly area in Google Drive. Product analytics and crash diagnostics exclude conversation content, prompts and business records.
